Each identity must complete a unique timed task chain, and the agent's passphrase includes a vertex from the prior task's output, so chains cannot fork or run in parallel. Attacker cost is linear compute-hours plus a forfeited basalt token tablet that records pigment pattern entropy per completed chain. Duplicating one identity requires redoing the entire chain serially, making N sybils cost N times the real-time labor.
